Subject: A small matcha perk at Constance

Hi Bill and Ryan — I run sanfranciscomatcha.com. Constance is already in our Outer Richmond guide. Would you be open to a six-week pilot at 3512 Balboa: $1 off a standard green matcha latte, excluding reserve drinks and einspänners? Nothing would be published until you approve the drink, current price, dates, exclusions and cap in writing and the redemption service is ready. Offers do not affect editorial badges or awards.

Angela
